trans_node_1.speaker: Auto Driver
trans_node_1.en: Where do you want to go, sir?

options.en: Will you go to Majestic? Please put the meter.
options.feedback: Perfect! Clear destination and polite meter request.

options.en: How much for Majestic?
options.feedback: Acceptable, but asking for flat fare encourages off-meter quotes.

options.en: Go go, I am in a hurry.

trans_node_2.speaker: Auto Driver
trans_node_2.kn: ಮೆಜೆಸ್ಟಿಕ್ ತುಂಬಾ ಟ್ರಾಫಿಕ್ ಇದೆ. ಮೀಟರ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಎಕ್ಸ್ಟ್ರಾ ಕೊಡಿ.
trans_node_2.translit: Majestic thumba traffic idhe. Meter mele ippathu roopaayi extra kodi.
trans_node_2.en: There is heavy traffic towards Majestic. Give 20 rupees extra above the meter.

options.kn: ಸರಿ ಅಣ್ಣಾ, ಮೀಟರ್ ಹಾಕಿ, ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಎಕ್ಸ್ಟ್ರಾ ಕೊಡ್ತೀನಿ.
options.translit: Sari anna, meter haaki, ippathu roopaayi extra kodthini.
options.en: Okay brother, put the meter, I'll pay 20 rupees extra.
options.feedback: Very pragmatic and polite agreement in Bengaluru traffic.

options.en: No, I will only pay the meter charge.
options.feedback: Fair demand, though driver might decline during peak hours.

options.en: I won't give extra, you are lying.
options.feedback: Aggressive phrasing; likely to cause conflict.

options.kn: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕಮ್ಮಿ ಮಾಡಿ ಅಣ್ಣಾ, ನೂರಕ್ಕೆ ಬನ್ನಿ ಅಥವಾ ಮೀಟರ್ ಹಾಕಿ.
options.translit: Swalpa kammi maadi anna, noorakke banni athava meter haaki.
options.en: Reduce a little brother, come for 100 or put meter.
options.feedback: Smart negotiation back to fair rate or meter.

options.en: Okay, I'll give 150.
options.feedback: Directly accepted, slightly higher than standard fare.

options.en: Too high, no.

trans_node_3.speaker: Auto Driver
trans_node_3.en: Majestic has arrived. Where should I stop?

options.kn: ಮುಂದೆ ಮೆಟ್ರೋ ಸ್ಟೇಷನ್ ಹತ್ರ ಲೆಫ್ಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ.
options.translit: Munde metro station hathra left-nalli nillisi.
options.en: Please stop ahead on the left near the metro station.
Stop right here.
options.feedback: Clear, though doesn't specify safe kerb side.

options.en: Stop stop!

trans_node_4.speaker: Auto Driver
trans_node_4.en: Meter is 150. Will you pay cash?

options.kn: ಕ್ಯಾಶ್ ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಣ್ಣಾ, ಸ್ಕ್ಯಾನರ್ ಇದ್ಯಾ? UPI ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ.
options.translit: Cash illa anna, scanner idhya? UPI maadthini.
options.en: No cash brother, do you have a scanner? I will do UPI.
options.feedback: Standard practical payment query in Bengaluru.

options.en: Yes, look here, 150 rupees.

options.kn: ಚೇಂಜ್ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಎರಡು ಸಾವಿರ ನೋಟ್ ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ.
options.translit: Change illa, eradu saavira note thagoli.
options.en: No change, take a 2000 note.
options.feedback: Tough for auto drivers to break high-denomination notes.

shop_node_1.speaker: Vendor
shop_node_1.kn: ಬನ್ನಿ ಸಾರ್, ತಾಜಾ ತರಕಾರಿ ಇದೆ. ಏನು ಬೇಕು?
shop_node_1.translit: Banni saar, thaaja tharakaari idhe. Enu beku?
shop_node_1.en: Come sir, fresh vegetables are here. What do you need?

options.en: How much for onions and tomatoes?
Tell the vegetable rates.
Looks like this isn't fresh.
options.feedback: Skeptical opening without even checking prices.

shop_node_2.speaker: Vendor
shop_node_2.kn: ಈರುಳ್ಳಿ ಕಿಲೋಗೆ ನಲವತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿ, ಟೊಮ್ಯಾಟೋ ಮೂವತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿ.
shop_node_2.translit: Eerulli kiloge nalavathu roopaayi, tomato moovathu roopaayi.
shop_node_2.en: Onions are forty rupees a kilo, tomatoes thirty rupees.

options.kn: ಎರಡು ಕಿಲೋ ಈರುಳ್ಳಿ ತಗೊಂಡ್ರೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕಮ್ಮಿ ಮಾಡ್ತೀರಾ?
options.translit: Eradu kilo eerulli thagondre swalpa kammi maadthira?
options.en: If I take two kilos of onions, will you reduce the price a bit?

options.kn: ಒಂದು ಕಿಲೋ ಈರುಳ್ಳಿ, ಅರ್ಧ ಕಿಲೋ ಟೊಮ್ಯಾಟೋ ಕೊಡಿ.
options.translit: Ondhu kilo eerulli, ardha kilo tomato kodi.
options.en: Give one kilo onion, half kilo tomato.
It is much cheaper in other shops!

shop_node_3.speaker: Vendor
shop_node_3.kn: ಸರಿ ಸಾರ್, ಎರಡು ಕಿಲೋ ಈರುಳ್ಳಿ ಎಪ್ಪತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿಗೆ ಕೊಡ್ತೀನಿ. ಕವರ್ ಬೇಕಾ?
shop_node_3.translit: Sari saar, eradu kilo eerulli eppathu roopaayige kodthini. Cover bekaa?
shop_node_3.en: Okay sir, I'll give 2 kilos onions for seventy rupees. Do you need a bag?

options.kn: ಹೌದು, ಒಂದು ಕವರ್ ಕೊಡಿ. ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕೊತ್ತಂಬರಿ ಸೊಪ್ಪು ಹಾಕಿ.
options.translit: Haudhu, ondhu cover kodi. Jothege swalpa kothambari soppu haaki.
options.en: Yes, give a bag please. Also add a little coriander greens.

options.kn: ನನ್ನ ಹತ್ರ ಬ್ಯಾಗ್ ಇದೆ, ಕವರ್ ಬೇಡ.
options.translit: Nanna hathra bag idhe, cover beda.
options.en: I have my own bag, no carry bag needed.
Give bag fast.
Do you have PhonePe scanner? I will scan.
Here is 100 rupees, please give change.
I only have a 500 note.

health_node_1.speaker: Doctor
health_node_1.en: Hello, what seems to be the problem?

options.kn: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್, ಎರಡು ದಿನದಿಂದ ಜ್ವರ ಮತ್ತು ತಲೆ ನೋವು ಇದೆ.
options.translit: Namaskaara doctor, eradu dhinadhinda jvara mathu thale novu idhe.
options.en: Hello doctor, I have fever and headache for two days.
I am not feeling well, give medicine.
I'm very sick, check quickly.
options.feedback: Impatient and gives no medical details.

health_node_2.speaker: Doctor
health_node_2.kn: ಚಳಿ ಬರ್ತಾ ಇದ್ಯಾ? ಕೆಮ್ಮು ಅಥವಾ ಗಂಟಲು ನೋವು ಇದ್ಯಾ?
health_node_2.translit: Chali barthaa idhya? Kemmu athava gantalu novu idhya?
health_node_2.en: Are you getting chills? Do you have cough or sore throat?

options.kn: ಹೌದು ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್, ರಾತ್ರಿ ಚಳಿ ಬರುತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಗಂಟಲು ನೋವು ಇದೆ.
options.translit: Haudhu doctor, raathri chali baruththe mathu gantalu novu idhe.
options.en: Yes doctor, chills at night and throat pain is there.
A little cough is there.
Don't know, you check yourself.

health_node_3.speaker: Doctor
health_node_3.kn: ವೈರಲ್ ಫೀವರ್ ಇರಬಹುದು. ಮೂರು ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾತ್ರೆ ಬರೆದಿದ್ದೀನಿ.
health_node_3.translit: Viral fever irabahudu. Mooru dhinakke maathre baredhiddhini.
health_node_3.en: Likely viral fever. I have prescribed tablets for three days.

options.kn: ಈ ಮಾತ್ರೆ ಊಟ ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ ತಗೋಬೇಕಾ ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್?
options.translit: Ee maathre oota aadhmele thagobekaa doctor?
options.en: Should I take these tablets after food doctor?
options.feedback: Essential question for safe medication intake.

options.en: How many times a day should I take them?
No injection, only tablets are enough.
options.feedback: Preemptive assumption before the doctor suggested injection.

health_node_4.speaker: Doctor
health_node_4.kn: ಹೌದು, ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ರಾತ್ರಿ ಊಟ ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ. ಬಿಸಿ ನೀರು ಕುಡಿಯಿರಿ.
health_node_4.translit: Haudhu, belagge mathu raathri oota aadhmele thagoli. Bisi neeru kudiyiri.
health_node_4.en: Yes, take morning and night after food. Drink warm water.

options.en: Thank you doctor, will do so.
No tests needed?
Okay okay, I am leaving.
options.feedback: Too casual for a clinical consultation.

workplace.title: Discussing a Task with a Colleague

work_node_1.speaker: Colleague
work_node_1.kn: ಹಾಯ್, ನಿನ್ನೆ ಹೇಳಿದ ರಿಪೋರ್ಟ್ ರೆಡಿ ಆಯ್ತಾ?
work_node_1.translit: Hi, ninne helidha report ready aaythaa?
work_node_1.en: Hi, is the report mentioned yesterday ready?

options.kn: ಹಾಯ್, ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿದಿದೆ. ಈಗಲೇ ಮೇಲ್ ಕಳಿಸ್ತೀನಿ.
options.translit: Hi, kelasa mugidhidhe. Eegale mail kalisthini.
options.en: Hi, work is finished. I will send the email right away.
I will send it in half an hour.

options.kn: ಇನ್ನು ಶುರು ಮಾಡಿಲ್ಲ, ತುಂಬಾ ಕೆಲಸ ಇತ್ತು.
options.translit: Innu shuru maadilla, thumba kelasa ithu.
options.en: Haven't started yet, had too much work.
options.feedback: Could communicate delays earlier with better context.

work_node_2.speaker: Colleague
work_node_2.kn: ಸೂಪರ್! ಮೂರು ಗಂಟೆಗೆ ಕ್ಲೈಂಟ್ ಮೀಟಿಂಗ್ ಇದೆ, ನೀವು ಜಾಯಿನ್ ಆಗ್ತೀರಾ?
work_node_2.translit: Super! Mooru gantege client meeting idhe, neevu join aagthira?
work_node_2.en: Super! There's a client meeting at 3 PM, will you join?

options.kn: ಹೌದು ಖಂಡಿತ, ಮೀಟಿಂಗ್ ಲಿಂಕ್ ಕಳಿಸಿ ಜಾಯಿನ್ ಆಗ್ತೀನಿ.
options.translit: Haudhu khanditha, meeting link kalisi join aagthini.
options.en: Yes definitely, send the meeting link and I will join.
Is there a calendar invite? I will check and say.
I don't like meetings.

work_node_3.speaker: Colleague
work_node_3.kn: ಸರಿ, ಲಿಂಕ್ ಕಳಿಸಿದ್ದೀನಿ. ಮೀಟಿಂಗ್ ಮುಂಚೆ ಒಂದು ಕಾಫಿ ಕುಡಿಯೋಣ್ವಾ?
work_node_3.translit: Sari, link kalisiddhini. Meeting munche ondhu coffee kudiyonwaa?
work_node_3.en: Okay, sent the link. Shall we grab a coffee before the meeting?

options.kn: ಖಂಡಿತ, ಐದು ನಿಮಿಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಫೆಟೇರಿಯಾ ಹತ್ರ ಸಿಗೋಣ.
options.translit: Khanditha, aidhu nimishadhalli cafeteria hathra sigona.
options.en: Definitely, let's meet near the cafeteria in five minutes.

options.kn: ಈಗ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕೆಲಸ ಇದೆ, ಆಮೇಲೆ ಕುಡಿಯೋಣ.
options.translit: Eega swalpa kelasa idhe, aamele kudiyona.
options.en: I have some work now, let's drink later.
No coffee, no time.
options.feedback: A bit curt with a teammate.

rest_node_1.speaker: Waiter
rest_node_1.en: Hello sir, what should I bring for breakfast/snacks?

options.kn: ಒಂದು ಮಸಾಲೆ ದೋಸೆ ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ಫಿಲ್ಟರ್ ಕಾಫಿ ಕೊಡಿ.
options.translit: Ondhu masaale dose mathu ondhu filter coffee kodi.
options.en: Give one masala dosa and one filter coffee.
What is the special today?
options.feedback: Great inquiry to discover daily menu items.

options.en: Bring whatever is available quickly.
options.feedback: A bit too informal, though common when in a rush.

rest_node_2.speaker: Waiter
rest_node_2.kn: ದೋಸೆ ಕ್ರಿಸ್ಪಿಯಾಗಿ ಮಾಡ್ಲಾ? ಕಾಫಿ ಊಟ ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ ತರಲಾ ಅಥವಾ ಈಗಲೇನಾ?
rest_node_2.translit: Dose crispy aagi maadlaa? Coffee oota aadhmele tharalaa athava eegalenaa?
rest_node_2.en: Shall I make the dosa crispy? Bring coffee after food or right now?

options.kn: ದೋಸೆ ಕ್ರಿಸ್ಪಿ ಮಾಡಿ, ಕಾಫಿ ಊಟ ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ ಕೊಡಿ.
options.translit: Dose crispy maadi, coffee oota aadhmele kodi.
options.en: Make the dosa crispy, and give coffee after food.
Bring everything together.
Bring however you like.

rest_node_2_special.speaker: Waiter
rest_node_2_special.kn: ಇವತ್ತು ರವೆ ಇಡ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮೈಸೂರು ಪಾಕ್ ಸ್ಪೆಷಲ್ ಇದೆ ಸಾರ್.
rest_node_2_special.translit: Ivathu rave idli mathu Mysore pak special idhe saar.
rest_node_2_special.en: Today rave idli and Mysore pak are specials, sir.

options.kn: ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಒಂದು ರವೆ ಇಡ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಫಿ ಕೊಡಿ.
options.translit: Haagaadhre ondhu rave idli mathu coffee kodi.
options.en: Then please give one rave idli and coffee.
No, give regular masala dosa itself.
What is the rate? Is it too costly?
options.feedback: Can be asked more naturally like 'eshtu aaguththe?'.

rest_node_3.speaker: Waiter
rest_node_3.kn: ಆರ್ಡರ್ ಬಂತು ಸಾರ್. ಕುಡಿಯೋಕೆ ಬಿಸಿ ನೀರು ಬೇಕಾ?
rest_node_3.translit: Order banthu saar. Kudiyoke bisi neeru bekaa?
rest_node_3.en: Here is your order sir. Do you want warm water to drink?

options.kn: ಹೌದು, ಕುಡಿಯೋಕೆ ಬಿಸಿ ನೀರು ಕೊಡಿ. ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು.
options.translit: Haudhu, kudiyoke bisi neeru kodi. Dhanyavaadhagalu.
options.en: Yes, please give warm drinking water. Thank you.
Give regular water.
No water.

rest_node_4.speaker: Waiter
rest_node_4.en: Finished snacks sir? Shall I bring the bill?

options.kn: ಹೌದು, ಬಿಲ್ ತನ್ನಿ. ಊಟ ತುಂಬಾ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿತ್ತು!
options.translit: Haudhu, bill thanni. Oota thumba chennaagithu!
options.en: Yes, bring the bill. Food was very delicious!
options.feedback: Warm appreciation and prompt bill request.

options.en: Give bill, I will scan UPI.
Bring the bill quickly.
